 - Snow Mountain: you get ice damage and frozen points over time, please buy some Warm Potions from the market.

 - Thunder Mountain: Hard Marble, Gem, Electric Crystal, Gold Crystal, Copper Crystal.
 - Dead Forest: Hard Wood, Iron Wood, Poison Crystal, Green Crystal.

notes.title: Monster path and Tower
notes.content:
Monsters will be summoned at specific locations and will continue moving towards the Seal Crystal. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45033351/8ace38b344743f355bde2c9fd41288f2fe8df383.png[/img]
You can see their path when you open the building mode.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45033351/303e2f0767d315ccb8c0c5b01e6c10296e40c5e7.png[/img]
The monster will more likely to move on road, because it will move faster.
If you build a tower in the middle of the monsters' path, the monsters go around it.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45033351/98eb0bf03e7b9444f4e7c7315e0bf4e70e6f0501.png[/img]
But if you build too many towers, the monster will go straight and attack the tower.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45033351/07c0b4479d19b0bfc182a0f84dec3d88c32ad56d.png[/img]
After build or move tower, make sure that the monster will not attack you tower.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45033351/e1d60529c7475b3a19a67dd57475b5efb6dbeecd.png[/img]

notes.title: Map and Resources
notes.content:
Along with the main map, there are 7 maps for you to explore: market in the west, copper mine and iron mine in the south, silver mine and mana spring in the south-east, gold mine and forest in the north-east.
Market: you can buy and sell resources, and equipment here. It also has a Wheel Of Fortune with many special items.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45033351/cc676df5bcba3966c41e01e1e07d9e30628d20ca.png[/img]
Copper mine: copper ore, rock, coal, hard marble, copper crystal.
Iron mine: iron ore, rock, coal, hard marble, iron crystal.
Silver mine: silver ore, rock, hard marble, silver crystal.
Mana spring: mana stone, mana crystal, rock, wood, hardwood, and many plants.
Gold mine: gold ore, rock, hard marble, gold crystal.
Forest: green crystal, rock, wood, hardwood, and many plants.
Their map also has some plants that can increase player attributes, but it will increase the Disacter Point a lot. Don't harvest that plant if your towers are not strong enough.

notes.title: Wave System
notes.content:
An easy wave of monsters will summon after 10 minutes. You can also instantly summon a wave by clicking the combat button [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45033351/d0f38b0778ba53a336e6a96d91574829ec85b05e.png[/img] next to the disaster bar.
After 3 easy waves, a harder wave ([b]Accident Wave[/b] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45033351/a19cfa1bc23c99fea7adc069fb00f86795210324.png[/img]) will summon, with some boss monsters.
After disaster level 10+, a more challenging wave will summon after 3 [b]Accident Wave[/b]: [b]Small Disaster Wave[/b] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45033351/33d094e045255de4cdc3d1891504efb605dbe34e.png[/img], with many boss monsters.
When the disaster level reaches 15+, [b]Small Disaster Wave[/b] will also summon some giant monsters. The giant monster has more HP, and can perform AOE attack, so it can damage and destroy towers.
As the disaster goes up, monsters will stronger and more numerous.
Next Update: [b]Great Disaster Wave[/b] with King monster after disaster level goes to 40. King monster has more HP and some special ability.
